adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil it unconditionally enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The `loading` template auto-reloads every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb), which will repeatedly hit the endpoint and enqueue again for unresolved URLs. The only throttling shown is inside `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` (lib/topic_retriever.rb), which is per-URL and happens after the job is already enqueued (so it doesn’t protect the request/job queue), and can be bypassed by varying `embed_url`. The embeddable check relies on `request.referer` host equality (ensure_embeddable), which is a client-controlled header and thus not a robust gate. This combination is a verifiable abuse/DoS vector introduced by the diff.
